Name: Bigger Riverlands Farm
Author: JessebotX
Description:
A bigger and better riverlands farm. Requires SMAPI 2.7+. Replaces Riverlands Farm.

[b][size=4]YES IT WORKS FOR OLD AND NEW SAVE FILES IN CASE YOU WERE WONDERING.
[/size][/b][u]For Old Save files, use mods like Passable Objects to get rid of debris and crops etc. that were used to be on an accessible tile. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2364?tab=files]Even More Secret Woods BushReset[/url] file to reset bushes.[/u]

[u][b][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[/b][/u][list]
[*]Only Requires SMAPI
[*]Map is 110x90 (default 80x65) tiles
[*]Swimming lake to regenerate and relax
[*]Pethouse for spring, summer, fall and winter
[*]Minecart Traveling System that warps you around the farm
[/list]
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[/list][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[b][[font=Courier New]READ THE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3025?tab=docs]DOCS[/url] OR THE Config_instructions.txt included in the mod FOR MORE INFO[/font]][/b]
In the [b]config.json [/b]file, by default, you will see this

[font=Courier New]﻿[quote]{
﻿"MapType": [b]0[/b]
}[/quote][/font]
0 = default
1 = instant access to swimming area and minecart system
2 = same as 1 but with no mountain
3 = same as 0 but with no mountain
